module: Assesses a vehicle's damage: overall level (none, light, moderate, severe) based on map.objects[id].damage, and per-zone breakdown. For the breakdown, the vehicle's oriented box is split into 27 cells (3x3x3) whose beam and collision damage is read; the cells are grouped into named zones (Front, Front Left, Rear, Top, Left...). Used by gameplay_util_crashDetection to tell where an impact occurred.
usage:
local lvl = gameplay_util_damageAssessment.getOverallDamageLevel(be:getPlayerVehicleID(0))
print(lvl.damageName, lvl.damageSeverity)
local avant = gameplay_util_damageAssessment.getSectionsDamageInfoRaw(vehId)
-- ... collision ...
local res = gameplay_util_damageAssessment.getTextualCollisionDamageLocations({vehId = vehId, oldSectionsDamageRaw = avant})
print(res.mostDamagedLocation)
notes: getOverallDamageLevel thresholds: <= 50 "No damage" (severity 0); above that, Minor up to 10000, Moderate from 10000, Severe from 30000 (and beyond 50000).
Cells are indexed from 0 to 26; x = floor((i%9)/3), y = floor(i/9), z = i%3.
Probable BUG: damageLocationScore is never set (only damageScore is), so bestDamageLocation is always nil and bestDamageScore 0; only mostDamagedLocation is usable.

Probable BUG: the zone key is named `fontLeft` (typo, with no effect on the displayed name "Front Left"). The ids 7 are duplicated (rearCenter and top) and the name "Rear" is used by both rearCenter and rear: in damagedLocations, the second entry overwrites the first.
If no cell has taken damage, intensity divides by 0 (maxCellDamage = 0) and can produce NaN.

getTextualCollisionDamageLocations / getTextualBeamDamageLocations modify the received `data` table: its oldSectionsDamageRaw (and newSectionsDamageInfoRaw if provided) are replaced by plain per-cell numbers.
Without oldSectionsDamageRaw, the previous state is assumed to be 0 for all cells; without vehId, player 0's vehicle is used.
Damage shown in debug (setDebug(true)) draws the 27 cells in magenta every frame.

getOverallDamageLevel.desc: Returns a vehicle's overall damage level based on map.objects[vehId].damage.

getSectionsDamageInfoRaw.desc: Reads the beam and collision damage of the vehicle's 27 cells.

calculateDamageVariation.desc: Measures the heterogeneity of a damage series: standard deviation divided by half of maxValue, capped at 1.

getTextualCollisionDamageLocations.desc: Compares current collision damage to a previous state and returns, per named zone, total, maximum, average, variation, intensity and score. Used to know where an impact occurred.

returns.desc: {damagedLocations (by zone name), mostDamagedLocation, totalDamage, bestDamageLocation, bestDamageScore}

getTextualBeamDamageLocations.desc: Same as getTextualCollisionDamageLocations but on beam damage (deformation), to know where the vehicle was damaged.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called when extensions are reloaded: saves the debug flag.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after reload: restores the debug flag.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame; in debug mode, redraws the player vehicle's cells.

setDebug.desc: Enables or disables debug drawing of the damage cells.
